**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Propagate cancellation through evidence decoding**

When `verifyMedia` is called from the export workflow (`src/export.cpp:328`), `beforeRead` is the export cancellation check, but this call invokes `openProjectImportEvidence` with a default, never-stopped token. The callback runs only once before the operation, while `openProjectImportEvidence` can then decode and hash each imported WAV—up to the configured 8 GiB limit—without polling it. If cancellation is requested during that validation, export remains unresponsive until the entire evidence pass finishes; pass the cancellation mechanism into the bundle/receipt/audio reads or expose equivalent per-read polling.
